title: Exploring the effects of Citrus aurantifolia fruits peel essential oil, cultivated in Al-Hasa, in Methotrexate induced kidney and hepatic toxicities: Network Pharmacology, Molecular Docking, and in vivo Experiments.
authors: Mohamed, Maged E; Younis, Nancy Safwat
one_liner_zh: 该研究探讨柠檬皮精油对甲氨蝶呤肝肾毒性的保护作用，虽含分子对接但核心为湿实验与网络药理学，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Ancient and medieval sources, particularly from Arabic and Mediterranean traditions, reported Citrus aurantifolia (Lime) as antidotes against poison, tonics for digestion, antibacterial and immunomodulatory effects. Moreover, its traditional use as a diuretic and antitoxic agent supports its ethnomedicinal relevance in managing renal ailments such as urolithiasis and toxin-induced nephropathies. Methotrexate (MTX) is consumed in several types of carcinomas. Still, numerous studies have stated MTX side effects, including kidney and liver damage. AIM OF THE STUDY: The purpose of the current study is to elucidate the defending strategies of Citrus aurantifolia (Christm.) Swingle (Rutaceae) essential oil (CAEO) in the amelioration of MTX induced hepatic and kidney toxicities focusing on the Nrf2/HO-1 and JAK2/STAT3/NF-kappaB pathways. MATERIALS AND METHODS: CAEO was extracted and its composition was investigated. After the acclimation period, rats were allocated into five groups. Normal and CAEO groups in which animals were given saline or CAEO orally (10 days). MTX group in which rat were given MTX (20 mg/kg ip, once on 4th day). CAEO-50/MTX and CAEO-100/MTX groups in which animals received oral administration of CAEO 50 and 100 mg/kg for 10 days and MTX (20 mg/kg ip, on 4th day). Histopathological, liver and kidney functions, Cytochrome c release and mitochondrial swelling assessment. Oxidative and nitrosative stress, Lipid peroxidation, Inflammatory mediators and apoptosis markers assessment. Gene expression of JAK2/STAT3/NF-kappaB and Nrf2/HO-1/NQO1were measured. RESULTS: CAEO showed a monoterpene-dominant profile. Integrated analysis of docking scores suggested that a small group of abundant monoterpenes, supported by selected sesquiterpenes, drives the predicted interaction with JAK2, with comparatively weaker binding to the Keap1-related target. The network pharmacology analysis of CAEO ingredients specified JAK2/STAT3 signaling as one of the key mechanistic insights into how CAEO might counteract MTX-induced organ toxicity. Co-administering CAEO with MTX decreased hepatic and renal function tests caused by MTX and improved liver and kidney architecture. CAEO with MTX increased GST, GSH-Px, GSH-R and SOD and diminished NO and MDA levels. CAEO effectively reserved the MTX associated cytochrome c release from mitochondria and lessened mitochondrial swelling. CAEO instigated the gene expression and levels of Nrf2, HO-1, NQO1 while reduced the gene and protein expressions of JAK2, STAT3 and NF-kappaB. CAEO reduced inflammatory markers (TNF-alpha, MPO and ICAM), apoptotic markers (caspase 3 and 9). CONCLUSION: CAEO considerably alleviated the oxidative and nitrosative stress, mitochondrial dysfunction, inflammatory and apoptosis responses caused by MTX. This shielding effect may be due to the decline in JAK2/STAT3/NF-kappaB and the triggering in Nrf2/HO-1/NQO1 pathways.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：古代和中世纪文献，特别是阿拉伯和地中海传统，报道了来檬（Citrus aurantifolia）作为毒物解毒剂、消化滋补剂，具有抗菌和免疫调节作用。此外，其作为利尿剂和抗毒剂的传统用途支持其在管理肾脏疾病（如尿石症和毒素诱导的肾病）中的民族医学相关性。甲氨蝶呤（MTX）用于多种类型的癌瘤。然而，众多研究已指出MTX的副作用，包括肾脏和肝脏损伤。研究目的：本研究旨在阐明来檬（Citrus aurantifolia (Christm.) Swingle）精油（CAEO）在改善MTX诱导的肝和肾毒性中的防御策略，重点关注Nrf2/HO-1和JAK2/STAT3/NF-kappaB通路。材料与方法：提取CAEO并分析其成分。适应期后，将大鼠分为五组。正常组和CAEO组，动物口服生理盐水或CAEO（10天）。MTX组，大鼠在第4天一次性腹腔注射MTX（20 mg/kg）。CAEO-50/MTX和CAEO-100/MTX组，动物连续10天口服CAEO 50和100 mg/kg，并在第4天腹腔注射MTX（20 mg/kg）。进行组织病理学、肝肾功能、细胞色素c释放和线粒体肿胀评估。评估氧化和亚硝化应激、脂质过氧化、炎症介质和凋亡标志物。测量JAK2/STAT3/NF-kappaB和Nrf2/HO-1/NQO1的基因表达。结果：CAEO显示出以单萜为主的成分特征。对接评分的综合分析表明，一小部分丰富的单萜，辅以选定的倍半萜，驱动了与JAK2的预测相互作用，而与Keap1相关靶标的结合相对较弱。CAEO成分的网络药理学分析将JAK2/STAT3信号传导确定为CAEO可能对抗MTX诱导的器官毒性的关键机制之一。CAEO与MTX联合给药降低了MTX引起的肝肾功能测试指标，并改善了肝脏和肾脏结构。CAEO与MTX联合使用增加了GST、GSH-Px、GSH-R和SOD，并降低了NO和MDA水平。CAEO有效保留了MTX相关的线粒体细胞色素c释放，并减轻了线粒体肿胀。CAEO促进了Nrf2、HO-1、NQO1的基因表达和水平，同时降低了JAK2、STAT3和NF-kappaB的基因和蛋白表达。CAEO减少了炎症标志物（TNF-alpha、MPO和ICAM）和凋亡标志物（caspase 3和9）。结论：CAEO显著缓解了MTX引起的氧化和亚硝化应激、线粒体功能障碍、炎症和凋亡反应。这种保护作用可能归因于JAK2/STAT3/NF-kappaB的降低和Nrf2/HO-1/NQO1通路的激活。
